hosting.comment: The app site (socioprophet-builder) now serves the unified cockpit (client-vue), not the retired app-vue builder. Mirrors the proven `cockpit` target: SPA rewrite only, and NO predeploy — deploy via socioprophet-web/deploy-cockpit.sh, which builds client-vue and injects the runtime Firebase config into dist AFTER the build (a predeploy rebuild here would wipe that injected firebase-config.js). The cockpit's backend calls resolve via window.__COCKPIT_CONFIG__ (sovereign) or the prophet-platform in-cluster proxies (connected) — never a Firebase /api rewrite.
